name: Skybound Lighthouse Island — Restored
description: A hovering tropical island with cliffs, palms, turquoise water and a lighthouse. The island rises and falls on a slow magical current while three clouds drift independently overhead. Now with animated beacon light, drifting aether wisps and visitor-reactive glow. Tall wind-swaying coastal grass, a walking hooded keeper and flowing water with downloaded wave-normal textures enrich the exterior.
